bindings.rationale: Connection creation discovery catalog inspection and bounded preview have durable independently authorized routes.
Semantic dataset publication spans a durable dataset lifecycle with mapping policy readiness and version routes.
Quality rules execution overview and immutable reports require independently addressable surfaces.
Customer and product analytics use dedicated analytical routes plus governed metric presentation filter and visualization capabilities.
Forecast specifications models backtests prediction and monitoring have durable lifecycle and evidence routes.
Pipeline definitions versions schedules and node inspection combine durable routes with contextual inspection and progress.
Export jobs are durable resources while preflight remains a transient confirmation owned by the source route.
Bootstrap and onboarding are resumable route-backed flows with an explicit session-expiry boundary.
Issue remediation has a durable route and transient publish or rerun confirmations.
Operational diagnosis requires durable run and attempt routes plus bounded progress and action confirmation.
Dashboard and published report snapshot sharing use their durable viewer routes plus explicit object access policy management.
Previous-year comparison is a governed reusable behavior on every reportable route rather than a standalone resource page.
Promotion definitions and history are durable while compact item inspection remains contextual.
Email composition policy and delivery history are durable; final confirmation and sender-policy checks are shared contracts.
Universal XLSX uses the export job route and shared snapshot metric-presentation and preflight contracts.
Data Guide registry editing publication and immutable reading require distinct durable routes.
ChartSpec rendering and its data-table alternative are reusable reportable-block contracts rather than independent resources.
Focus is a route-backed full-screen state on the origin URL with Trust and deterministic return instead of a separate modal page.
Methodology registry and versioned method detail have a durable reviewed lifecycle.
Research cases and workspaces are durable while composition and metric presentation are reusable block contracts.
Comments remain object-scoped contextual discussion with deep-link state and PII-safe rendering, not an independent content registry.
Membership administration and resource-specific access policy have separate durable routes with contextual denial explanation.
Global profile and Company Pack lifecycle is separated from workspace assignment and all channels resolve one pinned brand contract.
Template lifecycle import history resumable upload and result diagnostics are durable independently addressable surfaces with shared progress.

Population treatment is a governed reusable policy applied by analytical and segmentation workflows, with contextual diagnostics, progress and Result Trust disclosure rather than a standalone resource route.
Bucket, stratified and exact-K KMeans segmentation share one versioned builder and execution contract while published definitions and membership snapshots remain on existing segmentation routes.

Discount policy metric and methodology lifecycles reuse their durable data routes while Margin and Discounts owns the primary result; shared component cap PVM and trust semantics remain a reusable capability.
Organization hierarchy memberships leadership department policies grants and ownership have durable independently bookmarkable lifecycle routes while effective-access composition remains shared.
People and contributor profiles are durable privacy-scoped surfaces while redaction visibility filtering and activity summaries are reusable policies across libraries and department hubs.
